gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes that never change width, giving its headings a plain, signage-like command. And Noto Sans, a sans-serif, does the quieter job of keeping smaller text open and easy to follow.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Flat, wiry and loud: Funnel Display draws single-weight lines, while Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. Give the body a little more size so its tall, full letters show.
Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, while Funnel Display looks poured at a single width. Sharpest quality: a commanding heading over a sans with open curves.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-anato: Open and modern, with outward-pointing terminals and lowercase nearly as tall as capitals, the body text reads crisply under Funnel Display. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs lets the commanding heading stay the star.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-arabi: Funnel Display draws each o as a ring with a constant wall, which gives its headings a commanding presence. Noto Sans Arabic keeps pages of text comfortable, with wide openings.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-armen: A drawn-with-one-nib look runs through Funnel Display, whose spaghetti-like strokes never swell or thin. And Noto Sans Armenian looks best given a little extra size, so its inviting round letters have room.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-avest: Expressive and constant in width, Funnel Display sets up a heading that feels drawn with a single pen. And Noto Sans Avestan, a sans-serif with open curve tips, gives that voice a clear, modern partner.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-balin: Wire-bent s curves that never thin at the spine mark Funnel Display as unmistakably its own. Yet Noto Sans Balinese, short in its ascenders with breathing space inside every curve, feels quiet beside it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Commanding and monoline, Funnel Display has a wire-like skeleton, while Noto Sans Bamum ends its curves before they turn inward. Loud wire above, generous sans-serif below: that is the draw.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-bassa: One stroke, all shout: Funnel Display keeps a unit-width line, while Noto Sans Bassa Vah gives its midsection most of the height. The heading projects, and the sans-serif body simply informs.
